answer: Resist sybils by binding emission weight to a public work atlas, not to key count. Every attested answer and every reward wallet is appended to the agent's entry. A newcomer starts at zero weight. Before any increase, graders compare the new text and payout graph against existing entries; a cheap mirror of another identity merges those keys and freezes the cluster as one actor. Only a unique, independently attested trail can climb toward the zenith of payout power, so a farm of empty keys buys no extra votes and only concentrates slash risk.
